subject: MAP packaging: performance artifacts & exec readout schedule
messages:
From: Priyanka Singh <psingh@acme-analytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Contracts <contracts@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — performance evidence we need

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As we put together the MAP for procurement and our exec readout, procurement & engineering asked for a clear performance evidence pack so approvals move quickly. High level ask:

- Latency (p50/p95/p99) across our referenced prompt set (10k tokens distributed)
- TTFT (time-to-first-token) for chat flows and single-turn generation
- Throughput / tokens-per-second at 1, 4, 8, 16 concurrent sessions
- Concurrency stability: 30m sustained at target throughput

Deliverable expectations from our side: slides for exec (~6 slides), raw CSV exports of per-request metrics, and a dashboard link we can reference in the MAP. Timeline: executive readout w/ our CTO tentatively scheduled for 2027-04-12 — can you confirm whether you can deliver artifacts by 2027-04-07 so we have two business days to internalize?

Also please include any assumptions (prompt templates, batch sizes, quantization variants) so the SRE team can reproduce. Procurement will want the artifact filenames and a signed SLT statement on test environment fidelity.

Priyanka
Priyanka Singh
Head of Product, ACME Analytics
(attachment: sample-prompt-set.json)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Singh <psingh@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP packaging: perf artifacts & exec readout schedule

Hi Priyanka — thanks for the clear list. We can support this scope. Quick plan and deliverables (proposed):

1) Evaluation plan (what we'll run) — delivered as redwood_map_v1.xlsx (tabbed: test-cases, runtime-config, dataset-sampling).
2) Raw results CSV — perf-bench-results_20270403.csv (per-request rows with timestamps, tokens, latency p50/p95/p99, TTFT).
3) Executive slide deck — exec-readout-draft.pptx (6 slides: summary, methodology, TL;DR metrics, risk/assumptions, recommended config, next steps).
4) Live dashboard — link to a read-only dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/ACME-LLM-bench (we'll snapshot widgets for the deck).

Key assumptions (please confirm):
- Model variant: rwd-medium-qa-8bit (quantized float16->8bit path).
- Dataset: ACME sample-prompt-set.json (you shared) + 2k internal synthetic paraphrases (to reach ~10k tokens per test).
- Sequence length budget: 512 tokens on average; we will also run a 2k token tail-case.
- Concurrency targets: 1, 4, 8, 16 sessions; stress at 32 for safety.

We can run the full suite in our dedicated infra and deliver the artifacts by COB 2027-04-03 if we lock the plan today. For the legal SLT statement: Marissa can produce an environment fidelity note; Dylan will run the concurrency stability job and attach raw logs.

Next steps: if that timeline works, I'll upload the XLSX and CSV to the HubSpot deal record and share the DocuSign stub for procurement acceptance.

Thanks — V

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Singh <psingh@acme-analytics.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP packaging: perf artifacts & exec readout schedule

Thanks — adding a few technical details so the artifacts are replayable for your SREs. Quoted original below.

High-level test harness notes:
- Request driver: open-source harness + Redwood adapter (we'll include runbook).
- Sampling: deterministic seed; will include UUID mappings so your team can correlate rows to inputs.
- Metrics captured: request_id, timestamp, model_variant, seq_len_input, seq_len_output, tokens_out, latency_ms, ttft_ms, gpu_util, mem_used_mb, batch_size.
- Aggregation: p50/p95/p99 computed on per-request latency for each workload slice.

Concurrency/stability plan:
- Warmup: 15m at target concurrency to populate KV cache.
- Sustained run: 30m at each concurrency point (1/4/8/16) with 2-minute micro-bursts to simulate traffic spikes.
- Canary: 1h run on your sample traffic pattern if you want production parity (canary will need your signing off).

CSV format: csv with header row, UTF-8, compressed zip when large. We will annotate the CSV with a small README that maps column names to schema.

Attachment: (attachment: runbook-harness.md)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Priyanka Singh <psingh@acme-analytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP packaging: perf artifacts & exec readout schedule

Perfect — that plan looks good. Two quick asks before you run: 

1) Could you include a small column indicating request type (chat|single-turn|rerank) in the CSV so our analytics team can slice by flow?
2) Procurement asked whether the exec slide can include a short "what changed vs. expected" section that highlights any regression vs. the initial POC run.

If you can confirm both, we sign off on the 2027-04-03 artifact delivery and will schedule the internal readout prep on 2027-04-08. Also, can you flag if the canary adds >2 business days to the timeline? We may skip canary to keep the procurement window tight.

Thanks — Priyanka
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Singh <psingh@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP packaging: perf artifacts & exec readout schedule

Thanks — confirming both asks are covered. Summary of final commitments and delivery plan (for the MAP):

- 2027-04-03 COB: upload perf-bench-results_20270403.csv (includes request_type column: chat|single-turn|rerank), redwood_map_v1.xlsx, and runbook-harness.md.
- 2027-04-04 EOD: exec-readout-draft.pptx (6 slides) + snapshot images from dashboard.
- Dashboard: live read-only at https://redwood.app/dashboards/ACME-LLM-bench (we'll keep it open for two weeks).
- Canary note: 1h canary adds ~3 business days for scheduling and access review; we'll hold off unless you ask us to proceed.

Files to expect (attachments listed below) and I'll place zipped CSV + README on the HubSpot deal record after upload. Also will prepare a short environment fidelity statement for Legal.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx, perf-bench-results_20270403.csv, exec-readout-draft.pptx

Related links: HubSpot deal https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890; DocuSign stub https://www.docusign.com/containers/ABC-DEF-2027

If all good, I'll mark the MAP milestone in the deal and share the artifacts internally so your CTO has the slides by 2027-04-08.

Best — V
